newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF launches new bearing design for cars.
newsitem.headline: SKF launches new bearing design for cars.

text.p: Swedish ball bearing manufacturer SKF said on Monday it was launching a new bearing design for cars, SKF Hub Unit 5.
The new design reduces un-sprung weight considerably for vehicle makers and helps control drum deformation, SKF said in a statement.

"The concept was validated on a specifiCally designed test rig and with vehicle testing. During these vehicle tests, the superior performance of this new design concept, in minimizing brake-judder, was evident," SKF said.
Hub Unit 5 also continues the general industry trend of reducing piece count, which is important for stock control and assembly time reduction.
In the new design the drum is mounted on the outer diameter of the bearing flange and is secured using cold forming.
